subject: Contract renewal: geofence ops, EU data-zone and APAC burst roadmap
messages:
From: Lucy Park <lucy.park@medicorehealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medicorehealth.com>
Date: 2027-09-07T09:12:00Z
Subject: Renewal: contract & EU data-zone / APAC edge questions

Hi Markus,

We're approaching our renewal window for the platform (current term ends 2027-10-15) and want to fold in two things before sign: 1) firm commitments around EU data residency (we need an explicit EU data-zone option and proof of at-rest residency for PII), and 2) a staged APAC edge/burst plan for September-December to support a pilot program in Singapore and Tokyo.

High-level asks:
- Can you confirm you can route and store production traffic for our EU tenants exclusively in the EU data-zone?
- What does the APAC burst model look like (lead time, burst credits, pricing delta)?
- Need to understand cross-region failover behavior — if EU capacity is saturated or a regional outage occurs, how is failover handled and what telemetry is provided?

We want to present a clear mutual action plan to our legal + procurement next week. Please send any proposed contract language for data-zone residency and the APAC staging SOW.

Thanks,
Lucy
Lucy Park
Head of Platform Programs
MediCore Health

--
Attachment: MediCore_Renewal_Notes.txt (text summary sent internally)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Lucy Park <lucy.park@medicorehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-07T11:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal: contract & EU data-zone / APAC edge questions

Lucy — thanks for the clear asks. Appreciate the timeline.

Short answers up front:
- EU data-zone: yes — we can offer an EU-only data-zone option for tenant data at rest and in-transit. We will provide an addendum that codifies the residency guarantee and logging/audit scope.
- APAC burst: we propose a staged approach: (A) pilot (30 days) using our APAC edge with soft burst credits, (B) quarter-long burst capacity with reserved burst credits, (C) option to convert to Dedicated APAC capacity on a 3–6 month cadence.
- Cross-region failover: default policy is region-preferred with transparent telemetry; we can add a hard geofencing clause and an explicit failover SLA in the contract if you need no automatic cross-region routing.

I've attached a draft Mutual Action Plan and an EU Residency OPS addendum for your team to review. Deal ID: MDC-2027-111 — please include that in any redlines to help track in our quoting system.

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick alignment call (30m) this week to walk the addendum and pricing options — available 09/08 10:00-13:00 UTC.
2) We will supply a redline-friendly SOW for the APAC staged burst and an updated order form with optional burst credits.
3) If acceptable, legal teams can exchange markups and we aim to have signed order form by 2027-09-30.

Attaching: MediCore_MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf, EU-Residency-OPS-Addendum-draft.docx

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, EMEA
Redwood Inference

--

Date: 2027-09-08T08:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal: contract & EU data-zone / APAC edge questions

Lucy — quick note on commercial structure and timings from our side.

Proposal (high level):
- Core renewal: 12-month term with standard usage rates for EU tenants.
- EU data-zone addendum: small per-tenant premium to cover replicated storage and audit retention (we've modelled this as +6% on base token rates for accounts electing full EU residency).
- APAC staged burst: one-time onboarding fee + burst credit pool (consumable) billed monthly when used. If you convert to Dedicated APAC capacity within the first 3 months, we will credit 50% of the onboarding fee.

Pricing sheet attached (Pricing_Sheet_APAC_burst.xlsx) — shows sample scenarios for pilot (10k monthly requests), burst (50k peak), and dedicated baseline.

Can you confirm your procurement timeline so we can align billing/PO windows? We should also flag if MediCore needs SOC2/ISO docs for tranche approvals.

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Thanks Markus/Ben — we reviewed the docs internally. A few items from InfoSec and Procurement:

- We require explicit language that customer PII for EU tenants remains in EU physical storage (describe KMS boundary and key management).
- For cross-region failover, we need the option to opt-out of automatic failover and to trigger manual failover only after a declared incident.

Procurement:
- We prefer a 12-month renewal with an option for a 3-month APAC pilot extension.
- Please provide sample order form line items for: EU data-zone add-on, APAC burst credits (bronze/silver/gold), and a Dedicated APAC reserve option.

Redlines (short excerpt):
> Section 3.2 Residency: "Customer Data shall be stored and processed exclusively within the EU data-zone unless Customer provides written consent for cross-region processing."
> Section 5.1 Failover: "Automatic cross-region routing shall not be performed without prior Customer approval; emergency manual failover is allowed only upon notification and recorded incident declaration."

Can we schedule the 30m alignment call on 09/14 09:00 UTC? Legal will be on.

Best,
Lucy

Lucy — great alignment call earlier; summary and immediate next steps below.

Summary decisions:
- EU data-zone addendum: Redwood will provide the addendum with explicit residency language, KMS boundary details, and audit logging for PII. We agreed on the "EU-only by default" wording, with an opt-in manual failover path.
- Cross-region failover: we will include both options in the SOW: (A) Geofence-enforced (no automatic cross-region routing), and (B) Region-preferred with emergency manual failover. Your legal prefers (A) — we'll surface that as the default for MediCore.
- APAC staged burst: pilot to start 2027-10-01 for 30 days (soft burst credits). If pilot meets traffic targets, expand to quarterly burst pool with option to reserve Dedicated APAC by 2028-01-15.
- Commercials: 12-month renewal term; EU data-zone +6% premium (as discussed). APAC burst priced as credits; sample order lines will be in the updated order form.

Action items:
- Redwood (Markus/Ben): circulate redline-friendly SOW and Order Form by 2027-09-16 (includes line items for EU add-on, APAC burst tiers, Dedicated APAC convert option).
- MediCore (Lucy/Jake/Procurement): provide internal redlines to the addendum by 2027-09-22.
- Both: DocuSign workflow will be prepared; aim to execute order form by 2027-09-30.
